description: Irregularities and unverified items for review. Flagged items do not block the merge. Each links its evidence. Change requests can be made against any ID.

rows.item: BAL 'No Injuries Reported' vs NFL.com news on Lamar Jackson and Tyler Huntley (IR)
rows.reason: The report and the news disagree. The cause is not known and is not confirmed here.

rows.item: SEA 'No Injuries Reported' vs NFL.com news that Sam Darnold is ruled out for Week 10
rows.reason: The report and the news disagree. The cause is not known. Report inclusion rules are open (Q02).

rows.item: No official depth chart reachable: starter and backup cells left blank
rows.reason: NFL.com and the Commanders club page both return 404. Third-party depth charts are not official.

rows.item: CHI, DEN, PHI and TB not on the Week 10 report
rows.reason: The rest of the schedule was not read.

rows.item: No as-of timestamp on the injury report page
rows.reason: The page text shows no as-of timestamp. Only the fetch date (2026-11-12) is known.

rows.item: Injury descriptor blank for players with news reports of surgery or injury (Puka Nacua, Josh Jacobs)
rows.reason: The cell is blank on the NFL.com listing. Not filled in.

rows.item: Skill Lab committed numbers do not reproduce on a fresh run in this branch (12 files)
rows.reason: Examples: STR-06 tickets 857 committed vs 856 on rerun. Two hash seeds give identical output to each other, so hash randomness is not the cause; cause unknown.

rows.item: Every model and strategy number is computed from third-party inputs (nflverse)
rows.reason: The provenance file says NFL.com is the only official source, and it is used only for spot checks. Values shown with a method link; not official-source values.

rows.item: Skill Lab official-host allowlist includes github.com and weather.gov
rows.reason: verify_all.py allowlist includes www.weather.gov and github.com. github.com is not an official NFL source.

rows.item: validate.yml push trigger names session branch arena/29806afc-korea2 (its PRs #14 and #15 are merged)
rows.reason: Stale trigger; not changed here (shared workflow).

rows.item: COORDINATION.md still lists claims for four earlier session branches (arena/9e0420bd-korea2, arena/89b8d356-korea2, arena/652b0095-korea2, arena-29806afc) as active
rows.reason: Each branch's PR is merged or closed (#7 closed unmerged). Not re-claimed; logged for the integration owner.

rows.item: Root README (0 of 7 candidates) and Skill Lab (0 of 16 tested) report different counts
rows.reason: README (0 of 7 candidates), skill-lab (16 tested, 0 qualified) and tests/check_data.py (0 of 5 ranked) use different universes. Not reconciled.

rows.item: No historical prop prices, so prop ROI is blank for STR-10 to STR-14
rows.reason: The README says prop ROI cannot be measured here.

rows.item: Whether prize or points rewards for a strategy leaderboard need an Alberta licence or registration
rows.reason: AGLC regulates gaming in Alberta. The specific rule was not found.

rows.item: 28 HTML pages outside the published build do not carry per-row source columns
STR-16 (integrity control) shows 85% hit and +64.8% ROI
rows.reason: Shown only as a control. It is not a strategy result.

rows.item: Third-party depth-chart sites describe their data as 'official team depth charts' without naming an official source
rows.reason: No official source named. Not used.
